power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: Ka whati ki te kōpaki rino Unbreaking II.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: Ko te Kaitoi
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: He rangatira mahi, he pai ake te kounga o te taputapu, he pai ake hoki te mahi i te whakatika.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: He iti ake te utu o te whakahoutanga o te kōpaki, ā, he pai ake te roa o te wā.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Ka takahia e nga ringa noa te kohatu rite ki te kohatu kohatu.
Ka tango i te haurua o te kino mai i te ahi, i te waikura, i te magma, me te tahunga kiri whakapakari.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: Whakaputahia ki te 4 ngutu rino hei tīmata i te whakakao.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Te tunu kai
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: He tohunga tunu kai, he pai ake te kai i hangaia, ā, ka whiwhi i te bonus XP mai i te paowa.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: He Kai Pai
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: Ko te kai e hanga ana e koe, he mea nui ki te hiakai me te makona.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_iron_stomach: E ārai ana ki te hiakai me te ngenge.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_seasoned_pal: Ko ngā pānga o te rongoā ki a koe ka roa ake te 25%.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Ko te Piki a te Kaihanga
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: Ka whakapakarihia ki te hoari rino e hiahia ana nga kai tunu kai katoa ki te hoari pai.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Kaihokohoko
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: He kaihokohoko mohio, e kore e mutu te hokohoko a te tangata o te kainga, e kitea ana e ia he taonga iti i nga kaihokohoko haereere.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_trades.d: E kore e mutu te hokohoko a te tangata whenua mo koe.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: Ka whakawhiwhia e nga kaihokohoko huri noa ki a koe nga mahi rangatira o te kainga me te whai waahi ki te taonga iti.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_starting: Ko nga Emeralds e Tīmata ana
Whakatika ki te maramara hei whakatipu i to mahi tuatahi.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: Ko ngā pānga o te rākau ki a koe ka roa ake i te 15% ka mau tonu te manaaki.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_lucky_tr: +1 Lucky te waimarie e kitea ana he kaihoko pai.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: Kaitohutohu
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: He pūkenga tapu, he kaha ki te whakarei ake i ngā pūkenga makutu me te roa o te wā o te rongoā.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Ko nga tepu whakamiharo e tuku ana i nga whakamiharo pai ake i to taha.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: Ko ngā pānga katoa o te rākau e roa ana i te rua o te wā.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_turn_undea: Ko ngā pānga i runga i te hunga mate e tuku ana kia ngoikore mō te 4 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: Ka kite mārama ake i roto i te marama iti he taonga mai i runga.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: Kia mau ki tētahi pukapuka tuhituhi mō ngā inoi me ngā pūkete.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: Ko te pūtau
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: Ehara i te mea tino pai ki tetahi mea. I ētahi wā ko te ara tino māmā te huarahi tika.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Ko Fisher
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: Ko te ora i te taha o te wai e ahu mai ana i te waipuke, e kaukau ana me te rehu, ka timata ki te taraka manaakitia.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: Ko te Waimarie o te Wai
+1 Te waimarie i roto i te wai e pai ana te awa ki a koe.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_swim_speed: + 15% te tere o te nekehanga i roto i te wai.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Te haurua o te pakaru i te kino nga paru kua whakamahia ki te hohonu.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: Ka whakauruhia ki te tarutaru ika i whakauruhia ki te Lucky of the Sea I me te Lure I.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Ka whiwhi i te Tirohanga Po i raro i te wai.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Ko Mason
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: Ka tuku te kohatu ki nga ringa kua whakangungu ka pakaru tere ake nga kōpae, ka whakakiia te tinana e nga ringaringa o te ringa, ka taea tonu te tiki.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Ka takahia e nga ringa noa te kohatu rite ki te kohatu kohatu.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: +1 kākahu tūturu mai i te ora katoa o te hopu i te waea.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_speed: Ko te whakaeke i te aukati 25% tere ake.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_starting_pi: Te whakatipu me te mahi whaihua.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: +1 tāpae tāpae tae e matau ana te ringa o te kaihanga ki te wahi e mutu ana te taiepa.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Paladin
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: He toa tapu he hunga mate e hinga ana i te paanga, e kore e taea e te mate te pupuri, a ka ora te marama o te rama i nga whara.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_turn_unde: Ko ngā pānga i runga i te hunga mate e tuku ana kia ngoikore mō te 4 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_holy_armo: +2 nga whakangungu rakau te whakamarama ka tiaki koe.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: He pōhēhē te whakahou i a ia i roto i ngā kōpae e 8 o te tohu.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_starting_: Ka whati ki te hoari rino.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: E kore e taea e te mate te pa ki a koe.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: He rangatira o te mate e whakahau ana i nga pononga mate e pakaru ana nga wheua me nga kaiwhaiwhai whawhai ki to taha, engari ko to kaha ora ano e herea ana ki a raatau.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: Ka karanga i tētahi kōpaki kua mate ki te whawhai mōu. Max 2 i te wā kotahi. Ko te utu o te 6 o te āhua. 30 hēkona te whakawera. Ka whiwhi koe i tētahi kino mēnā ka mate i te pakanga.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: Ka karangahia he kaikawe-a-ringa ki te whawhai mo koe. Max 3 i te wa ano. Ko te utu e 4 te uara. 20 hēkona te whakawera. Ka whiwhi koe i te kino kotahi ki te mate ia i roto i te whawhai.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Te āhua o te hunga mate
Kua whakarōpūtia hei hunga mate mate, kua pakaru i te hauora, kua ora i te kino, kua kaha ki te mate, he ngoikore ki te mate.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: Te manawa e kore e mate
Kāore e hiahia ana ki te manawa, ka ora tonu i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Ka taea te kite mārama i roto i te pouri katoa. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (te taunoa K).
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: E 1.5 nga kino i ia hēkona ka tukuna ki te marama o te ra.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: 3 ngā ngakau (-6 HP mōrahi). He tinana e pakaru ana e te karaihe mate.
Ko te Whakapā Mai o te Mate
Ka heke te whakaora hauora māori ki te 40% o te tikanga.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Ko Gorgon
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: He mea whakamataku o te kiri kohatu, e whakamataku ana tona titiro, e pakaru ana ona pukupuku, engari ka whakaiti te taumaha o te kohatu i ia taahiraa.
Ka whakarewa i ngā hoariri katoa e tata ana ki a ia mā te Rēhitatanga V. E toru ngā utu o te kaha.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Ko nga ringa kohatu
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.desc: E wha ngā pānga anō mō ia pānga.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Te ātete pūmau I Ko te kiri kohatu e whakangahau ana i ngā pānga katoa.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_knockback_resist: He 50% te ātete ki te whakaheke.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: He whakarihariha
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.desc: E neke ana i te 20% iti ake i te ritenga.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: Te Whakatairanga Nui
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.description: 15% nui ake i te kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: Ka tahuna te kaha 50% tere te pupuri i te ahua o te kohatu e rere ana.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: Ko te Automaton
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: He hanga miihini e kore e ngenge, e mate hiakai rānei engari ka pakaru nga rongoā whakaora, he maere te whakaora māori, he taumaha hoki nga mahi katoa.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Te ātete pūmau I he anga whakarewa mārō e kore e pakaru.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: Ko te Takahanga Whakapaipai
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: Kaore e hiahia ana ki te manawa, kaore e taea te hinga.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: Kāore ia i te hiakai, he puna mana ā-roto.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: Kei te huna te pae hiakai Kāore e kai ngā mīhini.
Kei te huna te pae hau Kāore e pupuhi ngā mīhini.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: He ārai ki te whakaora, ki te hauora tonu, ki te mate hoki.
Ka taea e ngā pūoko opitika i roto i te whare te kite mārama i te pōuri.
power.neoorigins.automaton_heavy_chassis: E neke ana i te 15% tere anga taumaha, hikoi taumaha.
Ko te whakaora tūturu e mahi ana i te 25% ōwehenga hanga ki te mau tonu, kaua ki te whakaora.
power.neoorigins.automaton_knockback_res: 40% te ātete ki te whakaheke mai i te taumaha noa.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Ko Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: He kaiwhaiwhai moana hohonu nui i whanau i roto i te moana tuwhera e whakangaro ana i raro i te wai me nga whiu o te tinihanga, nga werohanga inki, me nga kaitiaki i karangahia, engari i takutai, i tahuna te ra, a kua maroke i runga i te mata.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Ka pupuhi i tētahi pōtae atarangi e whakamutua ana, e whakamutua ana i ngā hoariri katoa i roto i te whānuitanga o ngā kōpae e ono.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: Ko te Kahu Ink Shot
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: E pupuhi ana i tētahi pōtae pūhui e tino whakaroa ana i ngā hoariri i roto i te whānuitanga o ngā mokowhiti e 5, e rua ngā utu, e waru nga hēkona te whakawera.
E manawa ana i raro i te wai ki te mutunga kore, ka kite mārama i roto i te wai me te kore e haumanu.
